param.name: codeinclude.enabled
param.desc: Resolve coderef with this plugin instead of the built-in resolver.

param.name: codeinclude.remote
param.desc: Fetch coderef targets that are http(s) URLs.

param.name: codeinclude.highlight
param.desc: Apply build-time syntax highlighting to codeblocks with a known language.

param.name: codeinclude.default-language
param.desc: Language used when none can be detected (for example 'yaml'). Empty means plain text.

param.name: codeinclude.charset
param.desc: Character set for included files when coderef/@format does not name one. Default UTF-8.

param.name: codeinclude.fail-on-error
param.desc: Stop the build when an included file cannot be read.

param.name: codeinclude.html.css
param.desc: Embed the highlighting stylesheet in HTML pages that contain highlighted code.

param.name: codeinclude.local.root
param.desc: Directory local coderef targets must be inside. Default: the directory of the input map. '*' removes the limit.

param.name: codeinclude.remote.allow-hosts
param.desc: Space-separated host names remote coderefs may fetch from. '*' allows any public host.

param.name: codeinclude.remote.require-pinned
param.desc: Remote URLs that name a branch instead of a commit hash: warn, refuse (yes) or accept (no).

param.name: codeinclude.max-size
param.desc: Largest file, in characters, that a coderef may include. Default 1048576.
